verified_facts.text: The Ritz Paris hotel is at 15 Place Vendome, 75001 Paris, France.
verified_facts.excerpt: its principal place of business (the Ritz Paris Hotel) at 15, Place Vendôme, 75001 Paris, France

verified_facts.text: Swiss hotelier Cesar Ritz partnered with French chef Auguste Escoffier to open the hotel in 1898.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 1898, Swiss hotelier César Ritz partnered with French chef Auguste Escoffier to open

verified_facts.text: Coco Chanel lived at the hotel for 34 years and has a suite named for her.
verified_facts.excerpt: Coco Chanel; the latter, who lived here for 34 years, has a suite named for her

verified_facts.text: Ernest Hemingway, a regular, gives his name to both a suite and a bar at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: fellow regular Ernest Hemingway’s name adorns both a suite and (what else?) a bar

verified_facts.text: In 2012 the hotel closed for the first time in its history and re-emerged four years later with updated technologies and new facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: in 2012, the hotel closed for the first time in its history, re-emerging four years later with updated technologies, new facilities

verified_facts.text: A grand staircase winds up from the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: The majestic grand staircase still winds its way up from the lobby

verified_facts.text: All rooms have marble fireplaces.

verified_facts.text: Each Prestige Suite is designed to reflect its namesake, with antique books in the Marcel Proust suite and worldly souvenirs in the F. Scott Fitzgerald suite.

verified_facts.text: The marble bathrooms keep peach-colored robes and towels, a hue chosen by Mr. Ritz, and golden swan bathtub taps.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea with madeleines is served in the Salon Proust.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Bar, launched in September 2021, is a lantern-topped space serving cocktails inspired by astrological signs.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers facial treatments using La Prairie and massages with French-made oils formulated for Ritz Paris.
